This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

`pickLocale` splits the `Accept-Language` header by commas and returns the first matching supported language, ignoring any quality values (`q=...`). As a result, headers like `en;q=0.3, fr-FR;q=0.9` incorrectly fall back to English.
